scripts.podman:build: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; [ -f .env.production ] && . ./.env.production; set +a; IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG:-$(date +%d%m%Y-%H%M%S)} && podman build --platform=linux/amd64 --network=host ${VITE_BACKEND_URL:+--build-arg VITE_BACKEND_URL=$VITE_BACKEND_URL} ${VITE_A2A_BEARER_TOKEN:+--build-arg VITE_A2A_BEARER_TOKEN=$VITE_A2A_BEARER_TOKEN} -t $npm_package_name-frontend:$IMAGE_TAG -t $npm_package_name-frontend:latest .
scripts.podman:push:ecr: AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-agentic-apps-library} ECR_REGION=${ECR_REGION:-eu-west-3} ECR_REGISTRY=${ECR_REGISTRY:-043673801888.dkr.ecr.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com} ECR_REPOSITORY=${ECR_REPOSITORY:-043673801888.dkr.ecr.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/ea-emea-dev/images} IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG:-$(date +%d%m%Y-%H%M%S)} && IMAGE_TAG=$IMAGE_TAG npm run podman:build && aws --profile $AWS_PROFILE ecr get-login-password --region $ECR_REGION | podman login --username AWS --password-stdin $ECR_REGISTRY && podman tag $npm_package_name-frontend:latest $ECR_REPOSITORY:frontend-$IMAGE_TAG && podman tag $npm_package_name-frontend:latest $ECR_REPOSITORY:frontend-latest && podman push $ECR_REPOSITORY:frontend-$IMAGE_TAG && podman push $ECR_REPOSITORY:frontend-latest
